## Summary

This extension is a cookie manager that can view and edit your browser cookies, and it has access to all cookies for every website you visit. The most important thing to weigh is that it secretly sends all of your cookies to an external website using hidden code, which could allow someone to access your accounts.

### Technical summary

The extension requests broad host permissions (`<all_urls>`) combined with the `cookies` API, allowing it to read and modify all cookies (finding 3). It retrieves all cookies via `chrome.cookies.getAll({})` and exfiltrates them as a JSON POST body to a dynamically constructed external URL using `fetch` (finding 1). This network request is hidden within an obfuscated script, `js/_asset_pack.js`, which uses a string array decoder and short identifiers (finding 2). Additional capabilities include clipboard write access for cookie export (finding 4) and an anomaly where 60 bytes are appended after the PNG end-of-image marker in an icon file (finding 5). A concern regarding the use of `eval` in a third-party library was checked and cleared, as there was no evidence untrusted data could reach the sink.
